commands.name: install
commands.description: Install dependencies exactly as locked, matching .github/workflows/ci.yml's first step. This repository had no aigency.json before this file — added so gates can actually run rather than reporting 'tsc: command not found' against an empty node_modules.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Apply prettier. Bootstrap, not gate: it writes to the tree, and a gate whose verdict describes a tree it just changed is not a verdict. Ordered after install.

commands.name: build
commands.description: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json — the published dist/ actually compiles. Mirrors ci.yml.
